jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Troy School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Troy). Operates PK-8.
North Country Supervisory Union -- Troy School Board page (official).

board.post_note: Troy SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected at the annual meeting; vacancies are filled by board appointment under section 424. No term ends are published.

sources.note: Troy School Board minutes, Oct. 13, 2026 (official, via the NCSU Troy board page): "GASTON made a MOTION to the TES School Board Appoint, Ali Carpenter and Holly Wyllie to the School Board to fill two vacancies. - Approved, All in Favor" (appointment authority: 16 V.S.A. section 424). The current roster (NCSU page, 2026-2027 section) is Bathalon (Chair), Pepin (Vice Chair), Campbell-Morin, Carpenter, Wyllie. Documented chain: the March 10, 2026 reorganization seated Bathalon, Holly Pepin, Campbell-Morin, Damon and Phillips after the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Pepin and Campbell-Morin first appear there, replacing Amanda Pepin and Allyson Bathalon -- minted ELECTED off the post-election board, the confirming annual-meeting minutes not fetched); Damon and Phillips resigned in June 2026 (June 9, 2026 minutes); the board sat at three through September. Robert Langlands was appointed Sept. 23, 2026 but appears in NO later record and the Oct. 13 minutes still describe "two vacancies" -- he is NOT minted (no evidence he ever served). NO term ends are published for any Troy director in any fetched source. Same people: Bathalon is the Troy selectboard record; Wyllie is the Troy justice of the peace record.

directors.name: Gaston Bathalon
directors.note: Board Chair; continuing member across the 2024-25 through 2026-27 rosters. Same person as the Troy selectboard record. No term end published.

directors.name: Holly Pepin
directors.note: Vice Chair; first appears at the March 10, 2026 reorganization after the March 3, 2026 annual meeting -- minted elected off the post-election board. No term end published.

directors.name: Kara Campbell-Morin
directors.note: First appears at the March 10, 2026 reorganization -- minted elected off the post-election board. (The NCSU page lists her as "Kara Morin.") No term end published.

directors.name: Ali Carpenter
directors.note: Appointed Oct. 13, 2026 under 16 V.S.A. section 424 to fill a vacancy (minutes). No end stated in the minutes (the statutory endpoint is the next annual meeting; not minted as an end).

directors.name: Holly Wyllie
directors.note: Appointed Oct. 13, 2026 under section 424 (same motion as Carpenter). Same person as the Troy justice of the peace record. No end stated in the minutes.
